title: Highest Common Factor
description: The greatest positive number that divides two or more numbers exactly.

title: Least Common Multiple
description: The smallest positive multiple common to two or more numbers.
note: LCM is always greater than or equal to the larger number.

title: Relation Between HCF and LCM
formula: HCF × LCM = Product of Two Numbers
description: Relates the HCF and LCM of two numbers.

example.question: The HCF of two numbers is 6 and their LCM is 72. If one number is 18, find the other.

title: Prime Factorization Method
formula: Express numbers as product of prime factors
description: Find HCF using common prime factors and LCM using all prime factors.

example.question: Find the HCF and LCM of 24 and 36.

note: The most reliable method for competitive exams.
